principles.decision: If a native Apple-platform target is added, expose task-level read-only App Intents; do not assume App Intents and share extensions are interchangeable.
Record heading accuracy, orientation, and activity context when available; missing accuracy remains unknown.
Do not use unbounded planar approximations for engineering coordinate derivation; require explicit geodetic method, CRS, units, and error bounds.
Keep Shortcuts GET-only; future retry logic must account for idempotency and preserve error/freshness states.
